source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent face-free padlock and key progressing from pale pencil construction to thick felt-tip outlines and a restrained teal, mustard, brick-red, and charcoal marker palette.
source.notes: The process must keep one chunky three-quarter padlock with one arched shackle, one keyhole, two corner screws, one separate diagonal key crossing the lower body, two paired-ray comic glint groups, and one shadow. No face, text, logo, sticker outline, badge frame, floating extra key, or final-only feature is allowed.

process_strategy: Reserve the diagonal key footprint across the lower lock body in the first frame, build only the visible lock structure around that overlap, then add the keyhole, screws, hardware, glints, shadow, thick outline, and limited marker color cumulatively.

final_elements.name: padlock body, shackle, key, and shadow construction
final_elements.description: One pale rounded three-quarter body block, thick arched shackle route, diagonal key footprint crossing the lower body, and shallow oval shadow guide.

final_elements.name: complete padlock-and-key silhouette
final_elements.description: The rounded body, inner and outer shackle edges, side plane, separate key with round bow, center hole, shaft, and simple two-step teeth wrapped around the guides.

final_elements.name: keyhole, two corner screws, side band, and shackle joints
final_elements.description: One centered keyhole, exactly two visible corner screws, one side band, and two shackle joint collars on the established lock.

final_elements.name: two paired-ray comic glint groups and one oval shadow
final_elements.description: Exactly two small paired-ray angular glint groups around the lock and one broken charcoal oval shadow beneath the padlock and key.

final_elements.name: thick black outline and limited marker fills
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black felt-tip outlines, deep teal lock body, mustard shackle and key, brick-red side band, charcoal shadow, visible marker streaks, and small paper highlight gaps.

frames.visible_job: Places the pale rounded three-quarter lock body, thick arched shackle route, diagonal key footprint across the lower body, and shallow shadow guide.
introduces: padlock body, shackle, key, and shadow construction

frames.visible_job: Wraps the guides with the rounded lock body, side plane, inner and outer shackle edges, and one separate diagonal key with round bow, center hole, shaft, and two-step teeth.
requires_prior_elements: padlock body, shackle, key, and shadow construction

frames.visible_job: Adds one centered keyhole, exactly two visible corner screws, one side band, and two shackle joint collars to the established lock.
introduces: keyhole, two corner screws, side band, and shackle joints

frames.step_name: Set the comic glints and shadow
frames.visible_job: Adds exactly two paired-ray angular glint groups around the lock and one broken oval shadow beneath the existing padlock and key, then clarifies the key overlap.
introduces: two paired-ray comic glint groups and one oval shadow
requires_prior_elements: keyhole, two corner screws, side band, and shackle joints

frames.visible_job: Thickens every established contour and fills the lock body deep teal, shackle and key mustard, side band brick red, and shadow charcoal while leaving visible paper streaks.
introduces: thick black outline and limited marker fills
requires_prior_elements: keyhole, two corner screws, side band, and shackle joints
two paired-ray comic glint groups and one oval shadow

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens the established thick outlines, lock-and-key overlap, keyhole, screws, band, shackle joints, two paired-ray glint groups, limited marker fills, paper highlights, and oval shadow.

rejection_checks: The same face-free padlock, three-quarter angle, scale, shackle proportions, diagonal key position, and overlap must persist in all six panels.
One padlock, one key, one keyhole, two corner screws, two shackle joints, two paired-ray glint groups, and one shadow must appear before the final panel and persist.
No face, smile, floating extra key, text, logo, sticker outline, badge frame, new hardware, accent, shadow, or color area may first appear in the final panel.
The finish must show handmade marker streaks and imperfect outlines rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
